intro: Quantity Surveying is a high-demand skill in Real Estate & Construction. Mastering Quantity Surveying opens career pathways across leading organisations and significantly improves your match score with employers who prioritise this capability.

bodySections.heading: Why Quantity Surveying Is Essential in Real Estate & Construction
bodySections.content: Employers look for verified proficiency in Quantity Surveying to ensure team productivity, project accuracy, and modern technical capability. Candidates with demonstrated Quantity Surveying expertise consistently outperform those with only theoretical knowledge.
bulletPoints: Quantity Surveying is listed as a required skill in over 60% of real estate & construction job postings.
Employers prioritise candidates with verifiable skills over self-declared expertise.
Proficiency in Quantity Surveying accelerates career progression by 1–3 years on average.
Use TalentXcel Skills Assessment to verify and showcase your proficiency.

bodySections.heading: How to Learn and Demonstrate Quantity Surveying
bodySections.content: The most effective way to build Quantity Surveying proficiency is through a combination of structured learning, hands-on project work, and verified assessment. Showcasing your skill through a verified credential on TalentXcel significantly improves recruiter visibility.
bulletPoints: Start with structured online courses covering Quantity Surveying fundamentals.
Build 2–3 real portfolio projects that demonstrate practical application.
Complete the TalentXcel Skills Assessment to earn a verified credential.
List the credential on your Career Passport and resume.
